title: GeminiDraftResponse
description: Structured draft response returned by Gemini for one Service Photo POC listing job. This payload is draft-only and is used to populate the listing_draft_* tables.

schema_version.description: Version of the Gemini draft response schema.

extraction_warnings.description: Optional high-level warnings about uncertainty, unreadable labels, hidden accessories, or visual ambiguity.

overview.description: High-level product identification and condition summary.

product_name.description: Best-effort full product name based on visible evidence only.

brand.description: Visible or strongly supported brand name.

model.description: Visible or strongly supported model identifier.

product_family.description: Product family line, if identifiable, such as EOS, Alpha, Lumix, etc.

variant.description: Variant or submodel text if visible.

mount_type.description: Mount type where applicable, based on visible evidence only.

serial_number_visible.description: Only include if clearly visible in the images. Do not infer.

condition_summary.description: Short draft condition summary based on visible wear and presentation.

confidence_notes.description: Human-readable notes about uncertainty in identification.

visible_wear_notes.description: Visible wear, scuffs, damage, or cosmetic observations.

key_selling_points.description: Short draft text capturing notable strengths or included value.

confidence_notes.description: Human-readable notes about uncertainty in descriptive content.

specifications.description: Structured specifications extracted or inferred conservatively from the images.

other_specifications.description: Flexible JSON object for additional structured specs not modeled explicitly.

confidence_notes.description: Human-readable notes about uncertainty in specs.

included_accessories_text.description: Accessories clearly visible and likely included.

inferred_accessories_text.description: Accessories likely included but not fully certain.

missing_typical_accessories_text.description: Typical accessories that do not appear visible in the provided images.

confidence_notes.description: Human-readable notes about uncertainty in accessory detection.

pricing.description: Phase 5: combined pricing block returned in the same Gemini call as extraction. Gemini uses web search on eBay, MPB, KEH, and B&H to populate this. Optional because a grounded call may legitimately return no pricing when the product identity is too uncertain; the UI tolerates absence.

product.description: Human-readable product label Gemini used for the search (e.g. 'Canon EOS R6 Body').

pricing.description: Per-platform observed prices. Numeric USD or null when the platform had no match.

ebay_sold_avg.description: Average of recent Sold/Completed listings on eBay, USD.

mpb_retail.description: Current MPB retail for a comparable condition, USD.

keh_retail.description: Current KEH retail for a comparable condition, USD.

bh_used.description: B&H used inventory price if in stock, USD.

market_valuation.description: Synthesized valuation Gemini produced from the platform data.

fair_price.description: Recommended fair price for this item, USD. Flows into the CSV fair_price column.

deal_threshold.description: Price at or below which this would be a standout deal, USD.

market_summary.description: 2-sentence plain-English summary of the market position.

sources.description: Concrete listings Gemini used as evidence. Reviewer can click through to verify before approving the numbers.

uncertainty_tags.description: Markers for fields Gemini estimated rather than observed (e.g. 'mpb_retail [UNCERTAIN]').
